# How many doors does your property management company need to turn a profit?

> Free property management profit calculator: doors, fee percentage, leasing and renewal income, managers and admin in; monthly profit, break-even doors, the cost of your next hire, best fee and new-owner payback out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
